instruction: Candid street photograph, full-length shot. On a city crosswalk, the woman with long brown hair in a green coat (R1) on the left and the woman with short dark hair in a red sweater (R2) on the right embrace closely. The woman in the green coat wraps her arms around the waist of the woman in the red sweater, who rests her hands on the other's shoulders as they smile with their faces close together. In the background, a blurred pedestrian walks away under soft, diffused daylight.
elements: R1 wraps her arms around R2's waist
R2 rests her hands on R1's shoulders
R1 holds R2 lower at the waist while R2 places hands higher on R1's shoulders
R1 and R2 maintain a close face-to-face embrace with distinct waist-holder and shoulder-rester roles
